body.message:
We would like to inform you that you are welcome to extend your stay with us. However, please note that the extension rate has increased, and the rate for an additional 30 nights will be AED 9,000.

This is also the reason we are currently following up with all our in-house guests regarding their extension plans, so we can check availability and make the necessary arrangements in advance.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the extension, and we will be happy to assist you.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
